_about: Public-domain William Bell Riley (1861-1947), pastor of First Baptist Church, Minneapolis, and fundamentalist leader, for the Word Hoard: The Finality of the Higher Criticism, The Perennial Revival, Christ the Incomparable, Inspiration or Evolution, and volumes of The Bible of the Expositor and the Evangelist. He lived past 1930, so only books printed before 1930 are taken. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 100 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
